title: As Long as I Have Breath
lyrics: As [G]long as I have [D]breath, I will praise You;
As [Am]long as my [G]heart [C]beats, I will sing;
As [Em]long as life [C]flows in my veins,
How do I thank You, O Lord,
For all of the love in Your eyes?
And how do I thank You, O Lord,
For how You have changed me forever?
With favor and gladness and every good thing,
alternateTitles: How Do I Thank You O Lord
